firms can develop crowd capital through four types of crowdsourcing—crowd voting (e.g., online polls), micro-task (e.g., Amazon Mechanical Turk), idea (e.g., InnoCentive), and solution crowdsourcing (e.g., Threadless)—and that firms can use a three-step process to develop this resource.
